canada.title: Montreal light-rail trains evacuated overnight on Champlain Bridge
canada.summary: Two Montreal light-rail trains were evacuated in the middle of the night after coming to a stop on the Champlain Bridge.

canada.title: Hundreds charged, dozens of kilos of illegal drugs seized in police sweep across Manitoba
canada.summary: Police agencies across Manitoba seized dozens of kilograms of illicit drugs and 191 guns during a provincewide campaign that targeted street-level dealers in October.

canada.title: North Vancouver Mayor Linda Buchanan elected as chair of Metro Vancouver
canada.summary: City of North Vancouver Mayor Linda Buchanan has been elected chair of Metro Vancouver's board of directors, taking over an organization facing mounting pressure to overhaul its governance and finances.

canada.title: Accused’s mental state at heart of Nunavut murder trial
canada.summary: Danny Paul Eyaituk is on trial for first degree murder for killing his wife, 36-year-old Annie Tracy Oqaituq, in 2024 in their home in Sanikiluaq.

canada.title: Workplace safety charges laid in 2024 shooting death of Edmonton security guard
canada.summary: Workplace safety charges have been laid in connection with the death of an Edmonton security guard who was shot on the job two years ago.

canada.title: Children's hospital in Saskatoon adds 6 permanent beds
canada.summary: Six new beds are operational at the Jim Pattison Children's Hospital in Saskatoon, the province announced on Friday.

canada.title: Consultations open for new cannabis store in Rankin Inlet, Nunavut
canada.summary: Nuna Cannabis is proposting to open a store in the communuty, which would restrict public access to those 19 and over and be open daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m.

canada.title: Police watchdog clears RCMP in shooting death of Neqotkuk First Nation man
canada.summary: An independent police watchdog agency has cleared an RCMP officer of any wrongdoing in the fatal shooting of an Indigenous man in northwestern New Brunswick earlier this year.

canada.title: A place to call home, but only for six months: Yellowknife Housing First secures temporary housing
canada.summary: Tenants still face uncertainty after Northwest Territories Housing First secured temporary housing at a Yellowknife apartment building.

canada.title: Woman in her 20s dies after apartment fire in Quebec City
canada.summary: A spokesperson for Quebec City's fire department confirmed the woman's death after being found unconscious in her apartment building and transported to hospital. No signs of fire were visible from the outside of the building, and the fire was contained to one apartment.

canada.title: Further mental health assessment needed for man accused, along with wife, of storing body parts in bins
canada.summary: Michael Lee, 49, and his wife Helen Lee, 50, were each charged with indignity to a body after human remains were found in their Skyview Ranch home in October.

canada.title: Fredericton Exhibition still hopeful for deal with city on expropriation
canada.summary: The organization across the negotiating table from the City of Fredericton says a deal is still possible over the expropriation of land on the Exhibition Grounds.

canada.title: Water main break closes Mississauga city hall, other facilities
canada.summary: Mississauga city hall is among the facilities closed on Friday following a water main break.

canada.title: CUPE school workers vote to ratify deal with N.S.
canada.summary: Nelson Scott, president of CUPE Local 5050 in Cape Breton, confirmed the result to CBC News on Thursday night. The union's members include early childhood educators, janitors, librarians and bus drivers.

canada.title: Ottawa deems Whitehorse Power Centres project of national interest
canada.summary: The federal government has named the Whitehorse Power Centres as a project of national interest. It came during the Prime Minister's visit Thursday.

canada.title: Supreme Court of Canada upholds Quebec’s secularism law
canada.summary: In a historic judgment, the Supreme Court of Canada has upheld Quebec’s Bill 21, the province’s controversial secularism law that prevents public servants from wearing religious symbols while on the job.

canada.title: Flu season off to an early start, but microbiologist says still worth getting the shot
canada.summary: People may have been caught off guard by the early start of respiratory virus season — but one infectious disease researcher says it's not too late for Manitobans to get the flu shot.

canada.title: Trina Hunt’s family alleges husband killed her, seeks return of assets in B.C. lawsuit
canada.summary: A new civil claim alleges Iain Hunt killed his wife and should be barred from benefiting financially from her death. The allegations have not been proven in court.
